name: Classic Sourdough Patty Melt (No Grilled Onions)
whyItWorks: A fresh ground beef patty seared on the flat top with melted Swiss cheese on toasted sourdough provides hearty protein and simple fermented carbs. Swiss cheese is low in lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Crucial order note: Request NO grilled onions and light butter on the sourdough to protect sensitive digestion.
